messages:
lara: Heads up — noticed a spike in unassigned leads in HubSpot from the webinar form, looks like enrichment TTL is expiring before assignment :thinking_face:
kevin: saw that too, ~120 leads since 10:30am in fallback queue
sarah: I checked the workflows. Round-robin worker is hitting a case where enrichment returns null -> owner not set -> workflow routes to fallback queue
james: @sarah can you paste the property name and recent logs? tagging @devon to help
sarah: property is `mkt_enriched_owner_id`. enrichment lambda shows a bunch of 504s to /enrich between 10:28-10:34. retries don't kick in because TTL is 30s and cache expires earlier
devon: working on a hotfix: increase enrichment TTL and add retries. patch goin up now. snippet:
```
RETRY_COUNT=3
ENRICHMENT_TTL_SECONDS=120
```
kevin: should we also widen the assignment SLA window? current workflow bails after 30s which is too short when enrichment slows
lara: For webinar leads I support moving to 3m. We still need immediate auto-reply email, but assignment can be delayed a bit
james: short-term stopgap: if enrichment missing after 90s, assign to `inbound-fallback` SDR queue and add a note "pending enrichment" so AE can triage quickly
sarah: created GH issue GH-3215 to formalize the workflow change and add metrics
devon: deployed hotfix to rr-service (v2.3.1-hotfix). monitoring logs now
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: rr-service v2.3.1-hotfix by devon at 1738504420
kevin: eyeballing realtime: assignment throughput improved, fallback queue drain rate up, unassigned count dropping from 120 -> 15 in 6 min
lara: Nice. Next actions: add a HubSpot workflow rule: if Owner empty after 3m set Owner = `inbound-fallback` and create task for SDR with tag `pending_enrichment`
james: I'll own the HubSpot update and coordinate sales ops change window. pinging @maria (sales-ops)
maria: got it — can schedule the workflow push tonight 6-7pm PST to avoid peak. I'll also open a Salesforce sync ticket (SF-778) to ensure owner mapping persists to CRM
lara: SLA targets to record in the playbook: webinar lead handoff SLA = 90% assigned < 2m, 99% assigned < 10m. we'll monitor for a week
james: setting a short verification run: check hourly assignment rate and number of leads in fallback queue. I'll add a datadog dashboard and an alert if unassigned > 50 for > 15m
kevin: also recommend adding a small backoff/retry in enrichment lambda to avoid immediate null returns
sarah: noted. I'll update the GH issue with required tests and a QA checklist
devon: leaving an indicator flag `ENRICHMENT_SAFE_MODE` for rollback if anything funky happens
ops-bot: Alert: Datadog monitor `hs.assignment.latency` triggered at 1738504550 — spike observed; devon on it
kevin: metrics look stable again 10:45am, will keep monitoring for 2 hours
lara: thanks team. James — meeting at 4pm to confirm rollout comms and signoff?
james: yep 4pm calendar invite sent to marketing, sales-ops, eng-platform
maria: will prepare rollback runbook and note for SDRs so they know what to expect
lara: perfect. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks all, great quick triage
